title: Argentinian-German Stew with Roasted Vegetables
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by German cuisine, infused with the bold flavors of Argentina. This recipe features tender beef, roasted vegetables, and a tangy mustard kick.
instructions: Toss the carrots and potatoes with 1 tablespoon of oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the mustard, flour, and garlic to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the red wine and beef broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2-1/2 to 3 hours or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the roasted garlic and chopped parsley. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
